'''''Coronilla scorpioides''''', the '''yellow crownvetch''', is a species of annual herb in the family [[Fabaceae]]. They have a self-supporting growth form and compound, broad leaves. Individuals can grow to 20 cm tall.<ref>{{Cite web|title=''Coronilla scorpioides'' (L.)Koch - Encyclopedia of Life|url=https://eol.org/pages/689295|access-date=2022-02-04|website=eol.org}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|last=Mifsud|first=Stephen|date=2002-08-23|title=''Coronilla scorpioides'' (Yellow Crown Vetch) : MaltaWildPlants.com - the online Flora of the Maltese Islands.|url=https://www.maltawildplants.com/FABC/Coronilla_scorpioides.php|access-date=2022-02-15|website=www.maltawildplants.com|language=en-us}}</ref>
